name: Srinivasa Rao Gollapudi
title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer | Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
subtitle: Immediate Joiner | Remote Only

blocks.text: Senior DevOps Engineer and Site Reliability Engineer with 11+ years in IT, progressing from Linux and Windows Server administration into Microsoft Azure infrastructure, Azure DevOps CI/CD, AKS platform operations and SRE for enterprise clients in the UK and US, including LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group), MITIE and United Health. Hands-on with Azure Pipelines (multi-stage YAML), AKS, ACR, Helm, Terraform, Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, Azure Policy, Azure RBAC, Azure Monitor and Log Analytics. Recent work includes L3 escalation in a 24x7 on-call rotation, defining SLOs and error budgets with application teams, writing blameless postmortems and planning disaster recovery against RTO/RPO targets. Comfortable working independently in remote, distributed teams across time zones and mentoring engineers on pipeline practices.

blocks.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
blocks.org: Pulse Data Labs | Bangalore, India | Client: URUS
blocks.env: AKS, ACR, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Entra ID, Azure Policy, Azure RBAC, OPA/Gatekeeper, OpenTelemetry, PagerDuty, Backstage

items: Managed AKS workloads for the URUS enterprise SaaS platform, with container images in Azure Container Registry (ACR) and deployments through Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions pipelines.
Governed Azure access and configuration with Entra ID, Azure RBAC and Azure Policy, and ran OPA/Gatekeeper policy checks so compliance issues were caught before production.
Prepared disaster recovery plans for the Azure workloads aligned to agreed RTO and RPO targets.
Built reusable Terraform modules for Dev, QA and Production Azure environments and published them as self-service golden-path templates in Backstage.
Served as L3 escalation in a 24x7 PagerDuty on-call rotation, troubleshooting CrashLoopBackOff and OOMKilled pods, node pressure, ingress and DNS failures, and Terraform state drift.
Defined SLIs, SLOs and error budgets with application teams and tracked them on OpenTelemetry-based SLO dashboards.
Wrote blameless postmortems for production incidents, covering timeline, root cause and follow-up actions.
Added SBOM generation, Sigstore/Cosign image signing and SonarQube SAST/DAST checks to release pipelines.

blocks.title: DevOps Engineer
blocks.org: Teknip Technology Pvt Ltd | Bangalore, India | Client: MITIE
blocks.env: Azure DevOps, AKS, ACR, Helm, Terraform, App Service, Azure Functions, Application Gateway (WAF), Front Door, Key Vault, Entra ID, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Istio, Datadog, Ansible

items: Promoted to lead platform reliability and high availability for 10+ MITIE client applications, mentoring a team of DevOps engineers.

groups.heading: Project: Azure AKS and App Service Modernization
items: Created multi-stage Azure DevOps YAML pipelines with environment approvals, ACR image scanning and Helm deployments to AKS for 10+ applications, cutting release lead time from days to hours.
Built a hub-spoke VNet topology with Private Endpoints, Azure Firewall rules and NSGs, and deployed AKS and App Service workloads behind Application Gateway WAF and Azure Front Door.
Standardized Azure infrastructure as code with Terraform and automated configuration of 50+ VMs with Ansible.
Integrated Azure Key Vault with AKS through the Secrets Store CSI driver and Entra ID workload identity, removing hard-coded secrets from deployments.
Moved scheduled batch jobs to event-driven Azure Functions and set up Log Analytics workbooks and Azure Monitor alerts for each application.
Containerized legacy applications with Docker and packaged them as Helm charts for deployment to AKS.

groups.heading: Production Reliability and Security
items: Set up centralized logging with the ELK Stack and Fluent Bit for AKS clusters, giving support teams one place to search application and audit logs during troubleshooting.
Tuned alerting with Datadog anomaly detection and Prometheus/Grafana alert rules, reducing false-positive alerts by ~45%.
Automated TLS certificate renewal with cert-manager and Let's Encrypt on NGINX Ingress, removing certificate-expiry outages.
Rolled out the Istio service mesh on AKS for traffic management, mutual TLS and canary releases.
Added Trivy, Checkmarx and OPA/Gatekeeper checks to pipelines to block vulnerable images and non-compliant Kubernetes manifests.

items: Owned the Azure DevOps CI/CD platform for 20+ LSEG application modules, standardizing them on reusable Azure Pipelines YAML templates.
Converted manual release steps into reusable YAML pipeline templates for build and release automation, cutting deployment effort by 50%+.
Added secret scanning and dependency checks (GitHub Advanced Security, Dependabot) to release pipelines.
Built Jenkins shared libraries in Groovy and reusable GitHub Actions workflows so teams could onboard new services to CI/CD in hours instead of days.
Provisioned and hardened AKS clusters with Kubernetes network policies and Pod Security Standards.
Built Azure Monitor dashboards and led root cause analysis and postmortems on production incidents.
Mentored new engineers on Azure Pipelines authoring and Git branching standards.
Automated routine operational tasks with Python and PowerShell, saving 10+ hours a week.
